dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire It depends if the robot has full intelligence, as in a full ACTUAL individual AI - not the advanced word-match algorithm currently mislabelled as "AI" today. If it does, then yes it's cheating with another individual. If it doesn't then no, it's an advanced sex toy nothing more.

@dogecoin_empire Dating is similar - it's SUPPOSED to be the time where you're open and honest, about what you like and dislike, as part of getting to know each other. So yes, it's on YOU as a woman to also be clear about plans not just expect him to guess then dislike him for his choices.

@dogecoin_empire I've seen so many videos of a woman complaining that her guy cheated on her, and branding him just another "man who cheats for no reason" when that's rarely the case. Just as likely is SHE stopped being intimate with him, and he couldn't take it any more, but stupidly kept quiet.

@dogecoin_empire It's honestly the root cause of a huge majority of relationship failures and divorces and even cheating. One person will be unhappy about something in the relationship, but rather than actually clearly communicate that they suffer in silence until they can't take it any more.

@dogecoin_empire There's also power in the woman saying "hey I really love this place/love to eat this kind of food" instead of expecting the guy to be a mind-reader from day one. That's a huge problem that persists with both men and women it seems - being terrible at actual COMMUNICATION!

@dogecoin_empire And yet when we do this, the woman gets pissy over our choices and makes a video about it to share with complete strangers. Which is why we don't like making the plans any more. Especially in the early days of dating when you don't yet KNOW the woman well and what she likes.

@dogecoin_empire That's why it's so important to actually have a discussion about things like the sharing of household chores in a relationship, don't just "expect" or "hint" the bins to be taken out, COMMUNICATE that you need HIM to take them out and exactly how regularly that needs to happen.

@dogecoin_empire If you need to get something done or get something fixed, it needs to be said in plain language. Which is why we don't do well when it comes to women "expecting" things without actually communicating that CLEARLY - we simply don't DO hints or expectations without instruction.

@dogecoin_empire I think men tend to only have hidden meanings and hidden agendas when it comes to larger groups of us - especially when in positions of power like working for governments. Other than that individually we're far more straightforward. Hidden meanings/agendas doesn't get stuff done.
